name: TRINIDAD
lead: Trinidad and Tobago is a pair of islands. Trinidad lies 11 km off Venezuela. It gave the world the steelpan, calypso, and a wild street party. At dusk, thousands of scarlet ibis glow red in the swamps.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Trinidad was once attached to South America. The Gulf of Paria between them is so shallow you could almost wade across. The Northern Range is rainforest, and the south is flat, with lots of oil.
Tobago lies 30 km northeast, with coral reefs, quiet fishing villages, and jungle. Together the islands cover 5,131 km².
animals: The scarlet ibis is Trinidad's national bird. Thousands roost in Caroni Swamp and glow flamingo-red at sunset. The shrimps they eat make them red.
Tobago's bird is the cocrico, a noisy forest bird that wakes everyone at dawn. Both birds are on the coat of arms. The islands have 470+ bird species.
culture: Other carnivals copy Trinidad's. Before Lent, Port of Spain erupts in costumes and soca music. At J'ouvert, people cover themselves in paint and mud before sunrise.
The steelpan was born in the 1930s, when colonial rulers banned drumming. Young musicians hammered oil drums into tuned instruments. It is the only acoustic instrument invented in the 20th century.
history: Columbus landed in 1498 and named the island after three peaks. Spain, France, and Britain followed. Enslaved Africans worked sugar plantations until 1838, then workers from India arrived.
Oil was struck in 1857. Independence came on 31 August 1962, with Dr. Eric Williams as first Prime Minister. It became a republic in 1976.
wows: Pitch Lake holds 10 million tonnes of asphalt, which Raleigh used on his ships in 1595.
The UN made 11 August World Steelpan Day.
Brian Lara scored 400 not out in 2004, the highest Test innings ever.
Trinidad sits on the South American shelf, so it is not a volcanic island.
Pitch Lake heals its own cracks, and swallowed objects resurface years later.
Over 470 bird species live here, more than all of Europe.
Doubles, curried chickpeas in fried bara, were invented in the 1930s.

myths.fact: Trinidad lies south of the main hurricane belt. Big storms rarely reach it.
Carnival belongs to Trinidadians. It grew from the resistance of enslaved Africans.
